channel.title: Tool Use Cases: Daily builder log
channel.description: Daily log test, Nov 2–13, 2026. Weekdays only. Only verified breaking changes, deadlines and price changes. Published by Lali Publications.

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 11, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: MCP servers (server-filesystem): v2.4.0 (Nov 11, 2026) fixes two vulnerabilities in @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem 2.3.0. Package managers rank 2.3.0 below every 2025.x and 2026.x date version, so they won't offer it as an upgrade. Test for this: If you run a date version of server-filesystem, install it explicitly: npm install @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.3.0, then confirm the version your MCP client launches. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/releases/tag/v2.4.0 (checked 10:17 AM PT) | Breaking change: MCP servers (mcp-server-git): mcp-server-git 2026.11.11 (in v2.4.0) stops a repository's own Git config from making the server run a program, and refuses a Git older than 2.31. Test for this: Run git --version on every machine or image that runs mcp-server-git; upgrade Git to 2.31 or newer before moving to 2026.11.11. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/releases/tag/v2.4.0 (checked 10:17 AM PT) | Breaking change: MCP servers (mcp-server-fetch): mcp-server-fetch 2026.11.11 (in v2.4.0) now refuses IPv6 site-local fec0::/10 and other IPv6 addresses outside 2000::/3 without an IPv4 address, and matches robots.txt against the resolved path. Test for this: After upgrading, re-run any fetch calls that hit internal IPv6 hosts or paths like //private; expect them to be refused now. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/releases/tag/v2.4.0 (checked 10:17 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 10, 2026
item.description: Price change: Claude Code: In 2.1.321 (Nov 9, 2026), Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2) is added and is now the default Fable model: 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads. Test for this: If you pick Fable without pinning a version, run /model or check your usage after updating to confirm which model you're on, and re-check your per-task cost against the new rates. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.321 (checked 10:21 AM PT) | Breaking change: OpenCode: In 2.2.7 (Nov 10, 2026), ImageResponse.image is removed from @opencode/ai; read response.images[0] instead. Test for this: If your code imports @opencode/ai, search it for .image on image responses and switch to response.images[0] before upgrading. Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v2.2.7 (checked 10:21 AM PT) | Breaking change: OpenCode: In 2.2.7 (Nov 10, 2026), on a Location still loading plugins, SDK agent.list returns the agents loaded so far, and integration.list, usage.limits, vcs.init, rpc.call and artifact.* no longer wait up to 5 seconds. Test for this: If your SDK client lists agents or integrations right after startup, check that plugin-provided entries still show up; refresh on the matching *.updated event. Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v2.2.7 (checked 10:21 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 9, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: Claude Code: In 2.1.319 (Nov 6, 2026), auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways, asks about or denies calls the server can't check, with no fallback to the built-in classifier. Test for this: If you run Claude Code in auto mode behind a gateway or with telemetry off, run an unattended task and watch for new prompts or denials. Set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 to keep the built-in classifier (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged). Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319 (checked 10:08 AM PT) | Breaking change: Claude Code: In 2.1.319 (Nov 6, 2026), self-paced /loop ends when a turn finishes without rescheduling, instead of scheduling a fallback wakeup. Test for this: If you rely on self-paced /loop to keep checking on its own, confirm it still runs after a turn that doesn't reschedule. Set CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1 to keep the old behavior. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319 (checked 10:08 AM PT) | Breaking change: GitHub Copilot CLI: In 1.0.108 (Nov 9, 2026), creating or resuming an SDK session, or replacing its tools, with two custom tools of the same name is now an error. Test for this: If you build on the Copilot SDK, check that every custom tool you register has a unique name, then create and resume a session to confirm it starts. Source: https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/releases/tag/v1.0.108 (checked 10:09 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 3, 2026
item.description: Deadline: GitHub Actions: Starting Dec 2, 2026, GitHub Actions will block pull_request_target events by default in all public repositories unless an Actions event policy allows them. Brownouts run Nov 9 and Nov 16, 16:00-18:00 UTC. Test for this: Before Nov 9, use Insights to find workflow runs the rule would block, including AI agent or PR-review bots on pull_request_target. Allow the ones you need in an Actions event policy, or move them off that trigger. Source: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-02-pull_request_target-blocked-by-default-december-2/ (checked 10:10 AM PT) | Price change: Gemini API: gemini-2.5-pro is deprecated. Effective Dec 1, 2026, all API requests to gemini-2.5-pro automatically route to gemini-3.8-flash and are billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates, with breaking API changes. Test for this: Search your code for gemini-2.5-pro, switch it to gemini-3.8-flash before Dec 1, and test function calling, thought_signature handling, thinking_level (replaces thinking_budget) and any sampling parameters or prefilled model turns. Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog (checked 10:10 AM PT) | Price change: Gemini API: gemini-2.5-flash is deprecated. Effective Dec 1, 2026, all API requests to gemini-2.5-flash automatically route to gemini-3.5-flash-lite and are billed at Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates, with breaking API changes. Test for this: Search your code for gemini-2.5-flash, switch it to gemini-3.5-flash-lite before Dec 1, and rerun your evals: the same breaking changes apply (thought_signature validation, thinking_level, removed sampling parameters and prefill). Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog (checked 10:10 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 2, 2026
item.description: Deadline: Jules: Nine days left to keep working in Jules: sessions can continue until Nov 11, 2026, then Jules turns read-only until it shuts down on Dec 31, 2026. Test for this: Install Jules Tools (npm install -g @google/jules), run jules login, and export your settings, memories and sessions now; move open tasks to another coding agent before Nov 11. Source: https://jules.google/docs/changelog/ (checked 10:01 AM PT) | Price change: Bolt.new: Since Nov 1, 2026, Link (by Stripe) bills Bolt plan and domain subscriptions. Plans and token allowances are unchanged, but Link adds sales tax or VAT where your region requires it. Test for this: Check your next Bolt invoice for added tax. If you pay in a local currency instead of USD, expect the charge to move with the exchange rate. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 10:01 AM PT) | Breaking change: Bolt.new: Starting Oct 30, 2026, new Bolt database tables are private by default, so your app needs explicit permissions to read or write them. Existing databases are not affected. Test for this: Create a new table in a test project and read and write it from the app. If you get a database permissions error, ask Bolt to fix the table permissions. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 10:01 AM PT) | Deadline: Claude Code: Fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8 was deprecated on Oct 30, 2026 and will be removed on Nov 30, 2026. After that, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error instead of falling back. Test for this: Search your scripts, settings and API calls for fast mode on Opus 4.8 (speed: "fast" with claude-opus-4-8) and switch them to Opus 5.5 before Nov 30. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md (checked 10:01 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Oct 31, 2026 (format preview)
item.description: Deadline: Jules: Google is winding Jules down: you can keep working in sessions until Nov 11, 2026, then Jules is read-only until it shuts down on Dec 31, 2026. Test for this: Before Nov 11, export any sessions you need with the Jules Tools CLI (npm install -g @google/jules) and move open tasks to another coding agent. Source: https://jules.google/docs/changelog/ (checked 08:06 PM PT) | Breaking change: Bolt.new: Starting Oct 30, 2026, new Bolt database tables are private by default, so your app needs explicit permissions to read or write them; existing databases are not affected. Test for this: Create a new table in a test project and read and write it from the app; if you get a database permissions error, ask Bolt to fix the table permissions. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 08:06 PM PT) | Price change: Bolt.new: From Nov 1, 2026, Link (by Stripe) bills Bolt plan and domain subscriptions: plans and token allowances stay the same, but Link adds sales tax or VAT where your region requires it. Test for this: Check your next Bolt invoice for tax; if checkout offers your local currency, note the charge can vary month to month with the exchange rate, and USD stays available for a fixed price. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 08:09 PM PT) | Deadline: Lovable: Lovable's docs say the current chat pricing (per-message price and daily chat allowance) is a temporary offering that applies through Oct 31, 2026; the page does not say what applies after. Test for this: Recheck the Lovable chat docs and your plan's chat allowance on Nov 2 before budgeting chat-heavy work. Source: https://docs.lovable.dev/features/chats (checked 08:07 PM PT) | Deadline: Claude Code: Fast mode for Opus 4.8 is deprecated as of Oct 30, 2026 and will be removed on Nov 30, 2026; after that, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error instead of falling back. Test for this: Find scripts and settings that use fast mode with Opus 4.8 and switch them to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup before Nov 30. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md (checked 08:07 PM PT)
